Mixed adjacent-dimensional sphere wedges with inequivalent S5 symmetry modules distinguish it from nearby incidence and projective-plane examples. The result is a full integral homotopy classification and rational symmetry-module computation, not a restatement of known character or a tiny isolated numerical increment.
